mapper.select: SELECT a.user_id, a.account_id, u.nickname, r.persona_id, p.persona_name, a.seed_money, a.cash_balance FROM accounts a INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN results r ON r.result_id = ( SELECT r2.result_id FROM results r2 WHERE r2.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY r2.created_at DESC, r2.result_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN personas p ON p.persona_id = r.persona_id ORDER BY a.user_id ASC

SELECT a.user_id, hs.security_id, s.ticker, s.kis_code, hs.quantity FROM holding_securities hs INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = hs.account_id INNER JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = hs.security_id WHERE hs.quantity > 0 ORDER BY a.user_id ASC, hs.security_id ASC

SELECT hp.holding_product_id, hp.account_id, hp.product_option_id, p.product_type, hp.join_amount, hp.applied_rate, hp.total_installments, hp.paid_installments, hp.payment_date AS next_payment_date, hp.start_date, hp.maturity_date, hp.status FROM holding_products hp INNER JOIN product_options po ON po.product_option_id = hp.product_option_id INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE hp.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hp.account_id ASC, hp.holding_product_id ASC
